name: Unlimited Void (Muryōkūsho)
description: Brings the target inside the concept of Infinity, flooding their brain with endless information and rendering them completely paralyzed.

name: Malevolent Shrine (Fukuma Mizushi)
description: An open-barrier domain that continuously slashes everything within a 200-meter radius using Cleave and Dismantle.

name: Authentic Mutual Love (Shin'ai Sōkaku)
description: Fills the area with countless katanas embedded in the ground, each holding a randomly assigned Cursed Technique copied by Yuta.

name: Chimera Shadow Garden (Kangō Anbu Teien)
description: Floods the environment with shadow fluid, allowing Megumi to summon multiple Shikigami duplicates and hide in shadows.

name: Idle Death Gamble (Zaatsu Chappira)
description: A pachinko-themed domain that infuses rules into the target's brain, granting Hakari jackpot immortality.

name: Deadly Sentencing (Higashi no Shinki)
description: A court-themed domain prosecuting the opponent for past crimes using a Shikigami named Judgeman.

name: Self-Embodiment of Perfection
description: Applies Idle Transfiguration automatically to anyone caught inside the sphere domain.

name: Coffin of the Iron Mountain
description: Constructs a volcanic interior filled with molten rock and intense heat capable of burning average sorcerers.

name: Horizon of the Captivating Skiff
description: Manifests a tropical beach environment that unleashes infinite Shikigami swarms via Death Swarm.

name: Womb Profusion (Taijō Hōtai)
description: An open domain manifesting a totem pillar of twisted bodies, applying massive gravitational pressure.

name: Three-Fold Affliction
description: Allows Yorozu to hit targets with Liquid Metal or her Perfect Sphere generating infinite pressure.

name: Time Cell Moon Palace
description: Forces Projection Sorcery down to a cellular level, tearing apart targets moving against 24 FPS rules.

name: Idle Transfiguration (Hanami)
description: Interrupted before full manifestation; involves a flower field and solar-powered cursed beam devices.

name: Small Fry Fortune
description: An instinctual, incomplete domain created by cursed spirits holding Sukuna's fingers.

name: Yuji's Domain Expansion
description: Manifests as Yuji's hometown environment in Sendai, targeting the boundary between souls using Soul Dismantle.
